description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Baltimore County, MD. This is a confidential opportunity for a visionary leader passionate about delivering exceptional patient care and fostering a supportive environment.

As the LNHA, you will be responsible for the overall management and success of the facility, ensuring compliance with all state and federal regulations while upholding the highest standards of quality care. You will oversee daily operations, manage staff, and implement strategic initiatives to enhance resident satisfaction and operational efficiency.

This role offers a competitive salary and the chance to make a significant impact on the lives of residents and the professional growth of your team. Join a facility committed to excellence and innovation in rehabilitation services.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in the state of Maryland.
Bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, business management, or a related field.
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience as an LNHA in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility.
Demonstrated knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care.
Strong leadership, financial management, and communication skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive annual salary ranging from $115,000 to $145,000, commensurate with experience.
